item.name: 🎯 UserScope - Assignment

request.description:
Assign user to a specific division

**Use Case:** Class teacher for one division

**Access:** Only that division

Assign user to ALL divisions in a standard

**Use Case:** Subject teacher teaching multiple divisions

**Access:** All divisions (NULL = ALL)

**OVERWRITE STRATEGY**: Deletes all existing assignments for specified users, then creates new ones.

Assign specific divisions to user(s) in one request

**Use Case:** Teacher handles 2-3 specific divisions

**Efficient:** Single API call creates multiple assignments

**OVERWRITE STRATEGY**: Deletes all existing assignments for specified users, then creates new ones.

Assign multiple users to same scope

**Use Case:** Multiple teachers for same class

**Efficient:** Batch operation

Assign scope to ALL users in a role

**Use Case:** Default permissions for role

**Note:** Use roleName instead of userId

Assign coordinator to education stage

**Use Case:** Secondary/Primary coordinator

**Access:** All classes + divisions in stage

Assign principal with full access

**Use Case:** School principal

**Access:** Everything (all NULLs = wildcards)

item.description:
Create and assign UserScope permissions

## Patterns
- **Specific:** Provide exact IDs
- **Wildcard:** Omit field or set to null
- **Bulk:** Use bulk-assign for efficiency
